notes:
BUILD 16
- Minicopter: press F to take your hands off the stick and use what is in your belt. The craft holds its attitude until you press F again.
- Running: the gun or tool swings slow and wide instead of jittering; footfall rhythm no longer scales straight with speed.
- Trigger finger squeezes on every shot; on the pistols the other hand brings the new magazine up.
- Third person shows what you are holding.
- The sky no longer trembles when you turn.
- Scientists a notch harder again: 115 hp, 10.5 damage, better aim, shorter pauses.
- Helicopters take bullet damage now (60% of the round).
